_comment: Compound threat recipes (plan.md Phase 3). A recipe fires when several signals combine per its logic op — so robbery isn't dependent on a lone gun detection on poor CCTV. Signals map to detectors (weapon_candidate->weapons, violence->violence, etc.); person_down/running/masked_entry/counter_rush activate as those detectors land. Merge with a customer config or run standalone.

rules.name: armed_robbery
rules.title: ARMED ROBBERY IN PROGRESS
rules.gate_question: Do these frames show an armed robbery or coercive threat in progress — a weapon shown, staff/customers forced or fleeing, a counter rushed, or a person forced to the ground?

rules.name: violent_theft
rules.title: VIOLENT THEFT / GRAB-AND-RUN
rules.gate_question: Do these frames show a theft escalating to force or a grab-and-run — concealment or grabbing goods combined with a shove, struggle, or someone fleeing?
